definitions.rationale: Expands the named solutionProgram proof term into the exact translated constructor tree; it is a macro-style program definition rather than an execution rule or additional mathematical fact.
definitions.text:
rule solutionProgram =>
    Module(
      FuncDef("compare", Params("game", "guess"),
        If(Compare(Name("game"), CmpOp("==", ListExpr(.Exprs))),
          Return(ListExpr(.Exprs)),
          .Stmts)
        Assign(
          Name("difference"),
          BinOp("-",
            Subscript(Name("game"), Int(0)),
            Subscript(Name("guess"), Int(0))))
        If(Compare(Name("difference"), CmpOp("<", Int(0))),
          Assign(Name("difference"), UnaryOp("-", Name("difference"))),
          .Stmts)
        Return(
          BinOp("+",
            ListExpr(Name("difference")),
            Call(Name("compare"),
              Subscript(Name("game"), Slice(Int(1), NoBound, NoBound)),
              Subscript(Name("guess"), Slice(Int(1), NoBound, NoBound)))))))

definitions.rationale: Defines the base case of the recursive expected-output summary when the game list is empty.
Defines the negative-difference recurrence of expected by prepending the negated elementwise difference and recursing on both tails.
definitions.text:
rule expected(GS, US)
    => VCons(
         VInt(0 -Int (valueAsInt(headValue(GS))
                      -Int valueAsInt(headValue(US)))),
         expected(tailValues(GS), tailValues(US)))
    requires notBool isEmptyValues(GS)
     andBool (valueAsInt(headValue(GS))
              -Int valueAsInt(headValue(US)) <Int 0)

definitions.rationale: Defines the nonnegative-difference recurrence of expected by prepending the direct elementwise difference and recursing on both tails.
definitions.text:
rule expected(GS, US)
    => VCons(
         VInt(valueAsInt(headValue(GS))
              -Int valueAsInt(headValue(US))),
         expected(tailValues(GS), tailValues(US)))
    requires notBool isEmptyValues(GS)
     andBool notBool (valueAsInt(headValue(GS))
                      -Int valueAsInt(headValue(US)) <Int 0)
